reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Definition of practice of the law
headings.reviewNote: Defines "practice of the law" to include representative advocacy, drawing pleadings or documents, or performing acts in pending or prospective tribunal proceedings.

headings.title: Definition of law business
headings.reviewNote: Defines law business to include advising, drawing documents, or settling claims for valuable consideration.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections and extensive case annotations (Hulse, Automobile Club, Klingensmith, Hoffmeister, Thompson, First Escrow); removed erroneous "valuable consideration" phrase from subsection 1 note.

headings.title: Prohibition on unauthorized practice of law or doing law business
headings.reviewNote: Bars unlicensed persons and non-exempt entities from practicing law or doing law business, excepting chapters 356, 347, and 358 entities (*original rolls read "on" for "or").

headings.title: Misdemeanor penalty and treble damages liability for unauthorized practice
headings.reviewNote: Imposes misdemeanor fine and authorizes suits for treble amounts paid within two years, with state recovery rights.

headings.title: Prosecutorial duty to institute state recovery suits for treble damages
headings.reviewNote: Directs attorney general and local prosecutors to institute suits in the name of the state for treble damages.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections, original-rolls note (*"on" for "or"), and case annotations (In re Allstate, Carpenter) on unauthorized practice prohibitions, misdemeanor penalty, and treble damages.

headings.title: Permissive fingerprint requirement for Missouri Bar admission or reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Missouri supreme court to require fingerprint submissions as part of licensure applications for Missouri Bar admission or reinstatement.

headings.title: State and federal criminal history checks conducted through highway patrol
headings.reviewNote: Directs supreme court to submit bar applicant fingerprints to highway patrol for state and federal background checks.

headings.title: Fingerprint processing, FBI search, and supreme court record access
headings.reviewNote: Governs central repository and FBI searches, granting supreme court access to all discovered criminal records.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections; refined subsection 1 title to preserve permissive "may require" and include reinstatement alongside bar admission.

headings.title: Prohibition and misdemeanor penalty for attorney fee-splitting with non-lawyers
headings.reviewNote: Makes it unlawful and a misdemeanor for licensed attorneys to divide legal compensation with unlicensed persons or entities.

headings.title: Treble damage civil liability for unlawful fee-splitting arrangements
headings.reviewNote: Subjects violators to treble damage liability to payors within two years, with state enforcement rights thereafter.

headings.title: Prosecutorial duty to institute state recovery actions for fee-splitting violations
headings.reviewNote: Directs attorney general and local prosecutors to sue for recovery of treble fee-splitting amounts on behalf of state.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections and cross-reference (493.130, 493.140) on attorney fee-splitting misdemeanor penalties, treble damages, and prosecutorial enforcement.
